chapter.verse: Tu-a teng khit ciangin Topa in mi a dang sawmsagih-le-nih seh a, amahmah a pai sawmna khua leh mun khempeuh ah nihta a paikhol dingin sawlkhia hi.
Hih bangin zong amaute vaikhak hi: "Anlak ding tam napi nasemmi tawm hi. Tua ahih manin ama' anlakna phual ah nasem tampi hong puak nadingin anne Topa' kiangah nakpi thungen un.
Va kuankhia un. En un, ngiahon laka tuuno khah bangin note kong sawlkhia hi.
Sumbawm ahi-a thung-ip leh khedap ahi zongin keng kei unla lampi ah kuamah hopih kei un.
Inn khatpeuh na lut uh ciangin, 'Hih inn sungah nopna lemna om ta hen!' ci masa un.
Tua takah nopna lemna a deih mi a om leh na piak uh thupha ama' tungah tung ding a, a om keileh note' kiangah hong kileh ding hi.
Tua inn mah ah tungsuak unla amau' kiangah anne tuidawn un. A hang pen nasemte in thaman a ngah ding uh kilawm hi. Zin khatkhit khat khel kawikawi kei un.
Khua khatpeuh lutin amaute in hong san uhleh note' mai-a hong kiluui peuhpeuh ne un.
Khua sunga cinate damsak unla amaute' kiangah, 'Pasian' kumpigam nomau' tungah hong tung kuanta hi,' ci un.
Ahih hangin khua khatpeuh lutin khuamite in hong san kei uhleh kongzing lakah pai unla,
Ka khe uh-a hong baang na khua leivuite nangawn note' langkhat ah ka singkhia uh hi. Himah taleh Pasian' kumpigam hong tung kuanta cih thei ta un,' ci un.
Ke'n kong cihin ah tua ni ciangin Sodom khuamite in tua khua sangin thuaknop sazaw ding uh hi.

"Chorazin aw, na dahhuaizia! Bethsaida aw, na dahhuaizia! A hang pen note' kianga kibawl nalamdangte Tyre leh Sidon ah kibawl hileh amaute sawtpi pekin kisik khin ding uh a, puanhampi silhin vut lakah tu khin ding uh hi.
Ahi zongin Tyre leh Sidon in thukhen ni ciangin note sangin thuaknop sazaw ding uh hi.
Tua mah bangin Capernaum aw, vantung dong ah nang hong kilaamto ding ahi hiam? Leinuaia dong ah hong kikoihsuk ding hizaw hi.
"No hong kinbawlte kei hong kinbawl hi a, no hong nolhte kei hong nolh, kei hong nolhte kei hong sawlpa a nolh, ahi uh hi."
Sawmsagih-le-nihte nuamna tawh hong ciah uh a, "Topa aw, nangma' min hangin dawite nangawn in ko' thu hong mang uh!" ci uh hi.
Jesu in amaute hih bangin dawng hi: "Vantung pan khuaphia bangin Satan a kiasuk ka mu hi.
En un, gulte leh aikamte ahi zongin galpa' thahatna khempeuh ahi zongin, a tuancil dingin uktheihna thu hong pia khinzo ka hih manin kuamah in note hong nawksia lo ding hi.
Ahi zongin khat in na thu uh hong mang cih thu ah lungdam kei unla, vantung ah na min uh kigelh cih thu ah lungdam un."

Tua hunlenai sung mahin Kha Siangtho sungah Jesu nakpi lungdamin hih bangin ci hi: "Pa aw, vantung leh leitung' Topa nangmah kong pahtawi hi. Mipil thutheite' tungah hih thute na imcip a, naupangnote' tungah na lakkhia hi. Himah hi, Pa aw, tua pen nangma' deihsakna ahi hi.
Ka pa in na khempeuh kei hong ap khinzo hi. Pa simloh Tapa kua hi cih a thei kuamah om lo a, Tapa leh Tapa' theihsak nopte simloh Pa kua hi cih a thei kuamah om lo hi."
Tua ciangin nungzuite lamah kihei-in amau teng a tuamin hopih a, "Tu-a na muhte uh a mukha mittangte thuphangah ahi hi.
A hang pen ke'n kong cihin ah kamsangte leh kumpite tampi mah in na muhte uh mu nuam napi mukha lo uh a, na zakte uh za nuam napi zakha lo uh hi." ci hi.
Tua khit, en un, Jesu zia-et dingin thukhun hilhcian sya khat dingto a, "Sya aw, tawntung nuntakna luah theih nadingin bang ka hih ding hiam?" ci hi.
Jesu in, "Thukhun sungah bang kigelh hiam? Bang na simkha hiam?" ci hi.
Tua mipa in, "Na lungsim bup, na nunna kha bup, na thahatna bup leh na lungpilna bup tawh Topa na Pasian na it ding a, na vengte zong nangmahmah bangin na it ding hi, ci-in kigelh hi," ci hi.
Jesu in, "Maantak nong dawng hi. Tu-a bangin hih in; tua hileh na nungta ding hi," ci hi.
Ahih hangin tua mipa amahmah kidiksak nuam ahih manin Jesu' kiangah, "Tua ahihleh ka vengte cih pen kua ahi hiam?" ci hi.
Jesu in hih bangin dawng hi: "Mi khat Jerusalem pan Jericho ah paisuk a, buluhte in na man uh hi. A puante hawkkhiatsakin satliam gawp uh a, a sibaangin koihin paisan uh hi.
Tua khit, siampi khat tua lampi zui-in hong pai laizang a, miliampa a muh ciangin lamnawl tawnin khengsuak hi.
Tua mah bangin Levi mi khat tua mun hong tung a, amah zong miliampa a muh ciangin lamnawl tawnin khengsuak hi.
Ahih hangin khualzin Samaria mi khat miliampa' omna mun hong tung a, amah a muh ciangin hehpihhuai sa hi.
Miliampa' kiangah pai-in a liammate sathau leh lengtui a nuh khit ciangin puan tawh tuamsak hi. Tua ciangin ama' gan tungah tuangsak a, zinbuk khat ah paipihin khoi hi.
A zingciangin denarius tang nih lakhia-in zinbuk neipa pia a, 'Amah na khoi inla beibeh na neih peuhpeuh kong paikik ciangin kong loh ding hi,' ci hi.
Tua ahihleh hih mi thumte lakah buluhte' mat a tuak mipa' veng cih ding pen kua hi-in na um hiam?"
Thu hilhcian syapa in, "Amah a khual mipa," ci hi. Tua ciangin Jesu in, "Pai inla nang zong tua bangin gamta in," ci hi.
Tu-in amaute khualzin zomsuak uh a, lamkal khua khat ah Jesu lut hi. Martha minnei numei khat in amaute muakin zindo hi.
Martha in Mary kici sanggam numei khat nei a, Mary pen Topa' khe-phung ah tu-in a thugen ngai hi.
Martha ahihleh zindo nasep tawh buaikhop ahih manin Jesu' kiang pai a, "Topa aw, ka sanggamnu in kei kia zindo dingin hong nusiat awlmawh lo na hi hiam? Kei hong huh nading gen in," ci hi.
Ahih hangin Topa in dawng a, "Martha, Martha aw, vai tampi lunghimawhin na buaipih hi.
Ahih hangin a kisam khat bek om hi. Mary in sehtan hoih khat teel khinzo a, ama' kiangpan kilakhiakik lo ding hi," ci hi.Topa' Hong Hilh Thungetna
